title: Dong Hoi in a day
summary: The river, cháo canh at the market, the gate, the short walls, Tam Toa, Mother Suốt, and the beach at sunset.

stops.name: Nhat Le riverbank
stops.note: Walk the Nhật Lệ in the morning and look across to Bảo Ninh.

stops.name: Chao canh
stops.note: Eat cháo canh at Chợ Đồng Hới on Mẹ Suốt, in the morning or at midday.

approach.note: The market sits on Mẹ Suốt beside the river walk.

stops.name: Quang Binh Gate
stops.note: Look at Quảng Bình Quan, the south gate, on the walk through the center.

approach.note: The gate is on the morning walk through the center.
The walls are on the same center walk as the gate.

stops.name: Tam Toa bell tower
stops.note: See the ruined tower in the park on the river walk.

approach.note: Tam Toa's park sits on the river walk with the market and the bridges.

stops.name: Mother Suot
stops.note: Stop at the statue beside the river and the market.

approach.note: The statue is on the river walk beside the market.

stops.name: Nhat Le Beach
stops.note: Stay for sunset on the city sand.

seoTitle: Dong Hoi in a day — river, gate, walls, beach
seoDescription: A Dong Hoi day: the Nhật Lệ, cháo canh at the market, Quảng Bình Quan, the short walls, Tam Toa, Mother Suốt, and the beach.
